name: @accrualflow/edge-desktop
description: AccrualFlow Edge Desktop — tray-based operator console for enrolling and diagnosing an AccrualFlow Edge workstation.

scripts.package:linux: npm run agent:build && vite build && electron-packager . AccrualFlowEdge --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --extra-resource=../../agent --ignore='^/src' --ignore='^/release' --ignore='node_modules/(?!(better-sqlite3))'
scripts.package:win: npm run agent:build && vite build && electron-packager . AccrualFlowEdge --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --extra-resource=../../agent --ignore='^/src' --ignore='^/release'
scripts.package:mac: npm run agent:build && vite build && electron-packager . AccrualFlowEdge --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --extra-resource=../../agent --ignore='^/src' --ignore='^/release'
